_comment: Hornero recommended Claude Code settings. Copy into your project's .claude/settings.json (or merge with your existing file). The 'hooks' block wires Hornero's scripts into Claude Code lifecycle events — soft by default (warn, don't block); the aggressive variants are commented out for opt-in.

SessionStart.command: echo '↪ Hornero session — dispatch by scanning CATALOG.md first, then load only the chosen ROLE.md + SKILL.md.'

PostToolUse._comment: Soft: after any Edit/Write touching a SKILL.md, lint it. Warning only — never blocks the tool call. Replace <path-to-hornero> with your hornero clone (or drop this hook if Hornero is global via install.sh and you'd rather wire validate-skill into pre-commit).
PostToolUse.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" in *SKILL.md) <path-to-hornero>/scripts/validate-skill.sh "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" || echo '⚠ validate-skill warned — see above. Hook is non-blocking; fix before committing.';; esac

Stop.command: echo 'Session ending. Consider /extract-lesson if anything was surprising or worth capturing.'

_optional_hooks._comment: Opt-in guardrails. Move into hooks{} above to enable. Each one trades agent ergonomics for stricter invariants — adopt incrementally.

PreToolUse_block_invalid_skill._when: You want a SKILL.md edit to fail loudly if it violates anatomy (frontmatter missing, sections missing). Aggressive: blocks the tool call.

PostToolUse_auto_catalog_regen._when: You want CATALOG.md kept in sync automatically after any description-line change. Re-runs catalog.sh and stages the result. Adds latency to every SKILL/ROLE edit.
PostToolUse_auto_catalog_regen.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" in *SKILL.md|*ROLE.md) ( cd <path-to-hornero> && ./scripts/catalog.sh > /dev/null && git diff --quiet CATALOG.md || git add CATALOG.md ) ;; esac

PreCommit_smoke_check._when: Not a Claude Code hook — a git pre-commit hook. Install with: ln -s ../../scripts/smoke-check.sh .git/hooks/pre-commit. Runs full validate-skill + catalog-drift before any commit.

_notes: permissions.defaultMode: 'auto' lets the harness auto-approve known-safe tools.
skipAutoPermissionPrompt: true suppresses prompts for operations already in the allow list.
effortLevel: 'high' biases the model toward more thorough output (more tokens, better quality).
model: 'sonnet' is the default for new tasks; switch to opus for planning / haiku for trivial edits.
hooks.SessionStart primes the dispatcher behaviour at every session-start.

hooks.PostToolUse runs validate-skill.sh after SKILL.md edits and warns on failure. CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH stands in for whichever env var your Claude Code version exposes for the touched file — verify against the current hook docs before relying on it. If the var is empty the case statement no-ops, so the hook is safe-by-default.
hooks.Stop reminds the agent to consider /extract-lesson at session end.
_optional_hooks are commented examples — paste into hooks{} when you want stricter guardrails. Aggressive variants (blocking, auto-regen) trade agent ergonomics for invariants; adopt incrementally.
